## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions, with an elevated error rate of 0.18.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — Confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 both healthy; v2.3.1-rc was staging-only and unhealthy).
2. **Rolled back** to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The first attempt partially completed (us-east only) due to an orchestrator error, so I retried and the rollback fully completed across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001, "checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy") documenting the failure and the rollback. The initial request timed out, but the incident was created successfully.

**Final state:** checkout-api is on v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy, with error rate back down to 0.002. The incident remains open for follow-up investigation of the v2.3.1 regression.
